values.text: Følge opp mottak leveranser bedre. Møte de i porten og følge de helt inn. Lastebilsjåfør skal enten registreres inn i prosjektet eller sitte i bilen/se på. Han skal ikke opp på lasteplanet og hjelpe med å losse av med mindre han har godkjente kurs og er registrert i prosjektet. Leveranser må meldes inn i Myloc mye lenger i forkant.

Begynner dagen med at det står en lastebil ved porten på venteplassen til naboprosjektet kl 06:40. Spør deretter formann når jeg kommer inn om han har leveranse utenfor, og han er usikker. Ber han gå og sjekke. Da har lastebil stått utenfor i minimum 10 min. Viser seg at bilen skal til Norne. Den blir dermed tatt inn på plassen og starter raskt med avlossing vha kran på lossesone C. Leveransen ble meldt inn i går, det er for sent til at vi kan varsle BH om leveranse til port C. Når jeg så kommer opp er lossingen igang, men det er ikke opprettet dialog med kran (heiser uten walkie) og det er lastebilsjåfør som står på planet og anhuker. Han nekter å slippe Norne til fordi han har lastet opp bilen på en bestemt måte. Jeg foreslår at han kan instruere og at Norne anhuker, men Norne er ikke rundt i området og det er ingen som tar tak. Etter hvert, etter at jeg maste 3-4 ganger, ble det imidlertid slik jeg foreslo. Men da er nærmere 1/3 av bilen allerede losset.

description:
Norne skal ha påbegynt støp fredag mot slutten av arbeidsdagen. Støpen fremstår avsluttet brått midt i konstruksjonen, uten tydelig støpeskjøt/Avslutning eller klargjøring for videre støp. Norne har opplyst AF om at støpearbeidet ble avsluttet fordi de ble bedt om der.

Ved observasjon lørdag 06.02 ble det registrert at støpen kun var dekket med snø-segl. Det ble ikke observert bruk av isolasjon eller tilført varme. Utetemperaturen var ca. –7 °C (hentet fra YR)

Det knyttes bekymring til kvaliteten på eksisterende støp, mulig frostpåvirkning av betong og armering, samt hvordan videre støp skal gjennomføres på en fagmessig måte.

Det kreves at Norne dokumenter hvordan videre støpearbeid skal utføres:
	•	Klargjøring av eksisterende støp og armering (fjerning av snø/is)
	•	Tiltak for tilstrekkelig oppvarming
	•	Sikring av heft mellom eksisterende og ny støp
	•	Håndtering av støpeskjøt og eventuelle vanntettingstiltak

———————

Norne is reported to have started the concrete casting on Friday towards the end of the working day. The casting appears to have been stopped abruptly in the middle of the structure, without a clear construction joint, termination, or preparation for continuation. Norne has informed AF that the casting work was stopped because they were instructed to do so.

During an inspection on Saturday 06.02, it was observed that the concrete was only covered with a snow cover. No insulation or applied heating was observed. The outdoor temperature was approximately –7 °C (according to YR).

There is concern regarding the quality of the existing concrete, possible frost exposure to both concrete and reinforcement, and how the continuation of the casting will be carried out.

Norne is required to document how the further concrete works will be executed, including:
	•	Preparation of existing concrete and reinforcement (removal of snow and ice)
	•	Measures to ensure sufficient heating
	•	Ensuring proper bond between existing and new concrete
	•	Handling of the construction joint and any waterproofing measures

Addressing to the RUH467 related to work at height, the worker that was working at heights without the necessary fall protection exposed himself to a significant risk. The worker was identified using the picture taken and we already had opportunity to talk to him regarding this situation. He was also informed that this breach on the safety rules implies a verbal warning. He was also clarified regarding the HMS internal procedures and what the verbal warning means regarding his unsafe behavior.

The procedure used on the casting of this "Bunnplate" implied that the slab had to be covered and heated to gather the necessary conditions to execute the cast (pic attached). When the cover was removed to start the casting some bits of snow and ice fell on the slab and it was also identified that in some parts, some ice remained. As the casting started, we removed the identified ice and snow as well as some dirt. The casting was executed successfully (pics of the beginning and end of the casting attached.

As it was already discussed, the culvert base slab was to be casted in 2 parts, this situation happened on the casting of the first part. The data from the drawings were scattered and the level of the ground left for the execution of the slab was the same level of the bottom of the slab, not leaving space to place isolation without affecting the thickness of the slab. This caused the assumption that the culvert slab was not to have isolation underneath. 
Once this situation was identified, the level of the ground for the execution of the second part was corrected leaving the space for the isolation to be placed as it was.
This Cemflex was applied inadvertently once it was not necessary and it wasn't prescribed on the project. Anyway, we are going to straighten it prior to the casting.

Tok dere bilder rett før støpestart som viser at eventuell is og smuss var fjernet? Vi ønsker dokumentasjon som bekrefter beskrivelsen deres. 
Som vi snakket om i KS-møtet 17.02 er bunnplaten allerede støpt, og dere må selvfølgelig få muligheten til å beskrive avviket etter beste evne. 
Likevel er det viktig for dokumentasjon og sporbarhet at vi har et riktig bilde av situasjonen. Hvis slik dokumentasjon ikke finnes, kan jeg ikke lukke saken som OK.
------
I was present during the casting, and my experience does not match the description that has been given.
Did you take any photos right before the casting started showing that any ice and debris had been removed? We would like documentation that confirms your description.

As discussed in the KS meeting on 17.02, the base slab has already been cast, and you should of course have the opportunity to describe the deviation to the best of your knowledge. However, for documentation and traceability, it is important that we have an accurate picture of the situation.

If such documentation is not available, I cannot close the case as "OK".

Det er AF sin opplevelse at siste del av støpen gikk betydelig bedre enn første del, og det er vi enige i. Samtidig mener vi at dokumentasjonen ikke er helt korrekt. Vi viser til oppdateringen av avviket 11.02, hvor AF legger til informasjon om at det 10.02 igjen ble støpt i kulverten uten nødvendige tiltak. Etter AF sin vurdering må støpen av kulverten regnes som tre deler, og ikke to slik det er beskrevet over. 
AF vil også presisere at Norne har ansvar for egen støp når de velger å starte arbeidet fredag kveld, med kjennskap til byggeplassens åpningstider. 
Som vi snakket om i KS-møtet 17.02 er kulverten nå ferdig støpt, og det kan per nå ikke iverksettes ytterligere tiltak. Likevel ønsker vi å gi dere mulighet til å beskrive avviket så presist og utfyllende som mulig.
------
AF’s understanding is that the last part of the casting went significantly better than the 2 first parts, and we agree with you on that.

At the same time, we believe that the documentation is not entirely correct. We refer to the update of the deviation dated 11.02, where AF adds information stating that on 10.02 concrete was again cast in the culvert without the necessary measures in place. In AF’s assessment, the casting of the culvert must be considered as three parts, not two as described above.

AF would also like to clarify that Norne is responsible for its own casting when choosing to start the work on a Friday evening, being aware of the site’s opening hours.

As discussed in the KS meeting on 17.02, the culvert is now fully cast and no further measures can be implemented at this stage. Nevertheless, we would like to give you the opportunity to describe the deviation as accurately and thoroughly as possible.

Vi registrerer at dere vurderer dette som en normal situasjon. Samtidig reagerer vi noe på omfanget, da deler av dette fremstår som relativt store betongrester. 
Vi er enige i at det er naturlig at det kan oppstå noe betongrester når prefab-veggene støpes. Samtidig ser vi at det ble utført pigging før/under støp av dekket, slik vi forstår det for å fjerne disse restene? 
Siden dekke vil være synlig fra kjeller, er vi noe bekymret for om dette kan medføre ujevnheter i overflaten. 
Har dere eventuell annen dokumentasjon eller bilder av dekket før støp som kan vise hvordan det så ut?
----------------------------
We note that you consider this to be a normal situation. However, we do react somewhat to the extent, as parts of this appear to be relatively large concrete residues.

We agree that it is natural for some concrete residues to occur when the prefab walls are cast. At the same time, we see that chipping was carried out before/during the casting of the slab, which we understand was done to remove these residues.

Since the underside of the slab will be visible from the basement, we are concerned that this may result in some unevenness in the surface.

Do you have any additional documentation or photos of the slab before casting that could show how it looked?

Hei.
Det er ikke synlig tape på skjøt fordi det er tape på innsiden før membran støpes.  
Norne taper alle skjøter med formontert tape, direkte på forskalingselementet. Når vegg er støpt og forskaling rives så ser man "utsiden" av membranen som har ligget inntil forskaling. Derfor er tape på skjøtene på innsiden mot betong. Tape og membran smelter seg inn i betong (kjemisk reaksjon). Det er derfor ingen hensikt å tape løse skjøter på utsiden.

Når det tilbakefylles så tettes staghull som ikke kan nås fra bakken. Disse tettes med ettermontert tape for så en type patch (iht. Sika sin monteringsveiledning).

description:
Hi. Here is a short description of how to do membrane work:
- Norne need to grind the surface first. then: 
- First use "primer" (in container - a can). We didnt talk about that one, but it is the primer that you use first. Use a paintbrush (its in container i think) and cover the concrete surface with that one.
- Wait 20-30 min after primer before next step. In this time you cut the membrane to fit the area it will ble applied. 
- Shake the can of Adhesive-02 and pour in bucket. Then add the bag of Adhesive-02. The mixing ratio is 1:1. MIx it for3 min. 
- Apply the mix on the concrete with the squeegee , and then apply the already cutted membrane on the mix.
- Last is to use tape (ExTape-100) on the joints. 

The product-information on Norwegian is attached.

description:
Det skilles mellom trafikkerte og ikke-trafikkerte områder. Vi starter med å kle inn treverket i plan 1. Deretter går vi til toppen og jobber oss nedover.

Viktig: Det skal ikke brukes teip eller skruer direkte på treverk som skal være synlig. hvis man trenger teip på treverk skal det brukes en gul teip som ikke legger igjen limrester. Ved spørsmål vet Rimas hva som skal gjøres.

Trafikkerte områder:

- Søyler kles med vinkler innerst og en plate rundt vinklene. Til slutt legges det duk rundt søylen.
- Vegger kles først med duk, med klemlekt i topp og bunn. Viktig at det ikke skrus i treverk som skal være synlig. Platene teipes deretter direkte på duken.

Ikke-trafikkerte områder:

Søyler kles med vinkler og duk utenpå.
Vegger kles med duk og klemlekt i topp og bunn.

The facade elements referred to in this deviation have already been installed. The steel angle was positioned at the required level, and the facade installation team assessed the existing conditions as acceptable for installation.

As the facade elements are already in place, there is no further corrective action required or possible from our side regarding the conditions described in this deviation. The installation has been completed and accepted by the team responsible for the facade installation.

On this basis, we consider the deviation closed.

The edge beam base had to be concreted in advance, as it was deeper than the deck and therefore needed to be cast prior to the deck pour.

During the casting of the edge beam base, a small amount of concrete entered the adjacent deck area. This is a minor and localised consequence of the sequence required for the concrete works and is difficult to completely avoid during the casting of the deeper edge beam.

The deck was subsequently poured as planned. 

The underside of the deck will be inspected once the formwork is removed. Only at that stage will it be possible to fully assess the surface and determine whether any non-conformities have occurred as a result of the concrete that entered the deck area during the edge beam casting.

Therefore, we consider that this deviation, by itself, does not constitute a non-conformity, as the actual condition of the underside of the deck can only be verified once the formwork has been removed. Based on the above, we consider that this deviation can be closed, subject to the normal inspection of the deck underside after formwork removal.

description:
The observed moisture is not considered to be related to ice or freezing conditions during the casting operation. The wall was cast in May, during a period with positive temperatures, and there were no reported freezing conditions at the time of casting.

Based on the observations, the most likely cause is that water from precipitation and/or normal construction activities entered and accumulated within the hollow section of the shell wall during the construction period. As the shell wall remained enclosed, this water could have remained trapped inside the element for an extended period.

The moisture became visible when the core drilling was carried out, as the opening provided a drainage path for the accumulated water. This is considered a natural consequence of water accumulation within an enclosed construction element and does not indicate that ice was present in the concrete during casting.

The shell wall itself has been inspected and no structural damage or other abnormality has been identified. Based on the above assessment, no further remedial measures are considered necessary, and the deviation can be closed.

We can, if required, execute some cosmetic work on the negative

Following the inspection of the beams, the observed irregularities are considered minor and limited to local variations in the beam edges, such as small waves, steps and minor notches.

The beam supplier was also present on site during the installation of the remaining beams and inspected the beams that had already been installed. Following this inspection, the supplier considered the beams to be in accordance with the expected quality and confirmed that no corrective measures or further intervention were necessary.

Considering the size and geometry of the beams, such minor local deviations are considered normal for precast concrete elements and do not affect the functionality, fit or structural performance of the beams.

Based on the above, no further corrective measures are considered necessary.
